instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: The film wasn’t ((available)) in their area.
atoms.finishSound: The film wasn’t available in their area.

atoms.b: The festival was a way for the ((community)) to come together.
atoms.finishSound: The festival was a way for the community to come together.
The battle was a desperate struggle.

atoms.b: Did the fire alarm ((interrupt)) the class?
atoms.finishSound: Did the fire alarm interrupt the class?

atoms.b: It’s ((necessary)) to keep ice cream in the freezer.
atoms.finishSound: It’s necessary to keep ice cream in the freezer.
My nan has a TV programme.
